description: Free. Extraction status of 1-20 parts. A part being read reports current_step, elapsed_seconds, estimated_remaining_seconds with a range, and poll_after_seconds; a failed one reports its error; a part that isn't ready may list related_ready part numbers whose datasheet is readable now. A new datasheet takes about 2.5 minutes at the median and 6.5 minutes at the 90th percentile; a cold GPU start can take about 12 minutes. These are estimates, not deadlines. A part whose PDF is still being looked for reads 'resolving'. Not final. Keep polling while the status is 'resolving', 'queued', 'pending' or 'extracting' (after poll_after_seconds); stop at 'ready', 'failed', 'no_source' or 'unsupported'. datasheet_status: 'ready' → read it; 'extracting' / 'queued' / 'pending' / 'resolving' → poll check_extraction_status; 'not_extracted' → prefetch_datasheets; 'no_source' / 'unsupported' → request_datasheet_upload. Full list in the server instructions.

part_numbers.description: 1-20 parts. Specific manufacturer part number (MPN) or LCSC number (e.g. 'TPS54302DDCR', 'C2837938'). Not a value ('100nF'), description or reference designator ('R1').
